dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (Japan Medical Association open-source system), likely compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (claims) processing system — screen DID2 confirmation dialog handler
purpose.summary: This program is a screen-handling subprogram for the JMA ORCA medical receipt software. It handles the DID2 confirmation screen (screen 2 of a dialog), processing LINK and PUTG/CLICKED events to navigate between screens and set print flags (NO/OK). It calls ORCMCPSUB to perform window transitions.

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY statements (12 copybooks) for SPA areas, screen layouts, and MCP interface
LINKAGE SECTION with multiple passed areas (MCPAREA, SPAAREA, LINKAREA, SCRAREA)
EVALUATE on MCP-STATUS/MCP-EVENT/MCP-WIDGET for event-driven screen navigation
CALL to ORCMCPSUB for window management
Japanese comments encoded in EUC-JP or Shift-JIS (garbled in latin-1 decode)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — uses proprietary MCP middleware
verdict.notes: Comment text is Japanese encoded in EUC-JP or Shift-JIS, displayed as garbled latin-1 characters. The program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. Fixed format with a few lines slightly over 72 characters (likely column 73-74 used for sequence or continuation).
